notes.title: New Map "Whomp Library" Added!
notes.content:
New maps "Whomp Library", "Twilight Whomp Library" and "Midnight Whomp Library" arrived!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42282046/491b9d3547a968bb06982ce5179b4143919ecb0b.jpg[/img]

The new map is a dead-quiet library.

Even though it is quiet, don't let your guard down! The map changes as time goes by!?
Stay tuned for more thrilling, heart-pounding tag battles!

[h3][b] Map Introduction[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42282046/5ce2ead5224c407e1d4f5b53439c8aa9a574f161.jpg[/img]
Humans on the bookshelf are in full view of Monsters!
Sneak up from behind? Or slip through and hunt them down?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42282046/a81e37047db0e1612b4a446099e525a1574023be.jpg[/img]
Many places to hide in the library.
Duck behind bookshelves or in the shadow to get away from Monsters!

*The map delivery schedule for "Quick Match" will be changed due to the addition of new maps
